description: Keyword pin search — offset cursor, SERP window 40. Costs ~13 credits (0.5/result). Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass the nextCursor value returned in the previous response (numeric offset, e.g. 25). A null nextCursor means the end of the SERP window (max 40).

limit.description: Max items to return (default 25, max 200). Billed per result.

name: pinterest_search
title: Pinterest Search
